soldier: Head capsule yellowish brown, mandibles blackish brown, labrum yellow-white with the dorsal surface darker, antennae pale yellowish brown with the articulations slightly paler, thorax, abdomen and legs pale yellowish white. Pilosity of the head capsule moderate, the frons rather full, with a pair of short crossed setae in front of the frontal gland aperture; the anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum each with 20 to more than 30 setae. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.63–0.65, the sides nearly parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded; coronal suture distinct, about half the length of the head capsule. In profile the dorsal margin of the head slopes gradually backwards from the top of the frons, the frontal slope about 30°. Labrum slightly longer than wide, inclined somewhat to the right, the apex deeply U-shaped incised, the anterior lateral corners pointed and projecting forwards. Apex of the left mandible hooked, the mandibular body behind the hook bar-like, slightly twisted into an S from the anterior third backwards; right mandible sabre-shaped, the apex slightly curved, the inner margin of the mandibular base with two small blunt tooth-like projections. Antennae 14 segments, the second the shortest, the third the longest. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the middle of the anterior margin cut in as a triangle. Apical tibial spur formula 2:2:2.
